**Locator: extracted HTML block 30** (AMLO 2006 campaign platform — economic policy positions)

Block 30 covers the 2006 campaign program ("Por el Bien de Todos"). Verifiable intents:
- FOBAPROA critique (S00001)
- PAN/PRI propaganda attacks framing AMLO as danger (S00002-S00003)
- "Primero los pobres" / leftist platform diagnosing privileges-corruption-plunder (S00004-S00005)
- Anti-corruption: sweep from top, combat fraud/tax evasion, cut current spending, halve presidential salary (S00006-S00007)
- Commission of Truth to investigate FOBAPROA (S00008)

**Locator: extracted HTML block 31** (Specific platform proposals)

- 100 billion pesos first-year savings from austerity redirected to social programs (S00001)
- More effective tax collection to fund programs (S00002)
- Extension of public services to vulnerable groups (S00003)
- Productive-sector support: agriculture, tourism, public works (S00004)
- Energy sector: efficiency reforms only, no privatization of Pemex (S00005-S00006)
- Constitutional right to "just" and "dignified" wage (S00006-S00007)
- NAFTA: development cooperation chapter + protections for national agricultural producers (S00007-S00008)
- Migration priority, opposed walls/militarization (S00008-S00009)

**Locator: extracted HTML block 32** (Foreign policy distance from Chávez; June 23 polls; election night)

- AMLO declined continental policy comments; no personal/institutional relationship with Chávez (S00001-S00003)
- PRD distanced from Bolivarian strategy (S00004-S00005)
- June 23, 2006: last day for polls per COFIPE; 5 polls: 3 AMLO +1-3 pts, 1 tie, 1 Calderón +2; vote shares 33-36% (S00006-S00008)
- Madrazo out of contention (S00009)
- Both candidates proclaimed victory on election night against IFE advice; exit polls showed ~36% tie (S00010-S00011)
- July 3 PREP: Calderón +400,000 votes at 98.4% count; 36.38% vs 35.34%, gap 1.04% (S00012-S00014)

**Locator: extracted HTML block 33** (Post-election dispute)

- AMLO alleged irregularities/manipulations (S00001)
- EU observers dismissed fraud possibility; both proclaimed victory again (S00002)
- July 4: PREP with inconsistent actas reduced gap to 0.64% (S00003)
- July 5 official count: Calderón 35.89%, AMLO 35.31%, Madrazo 22.26%; gap 0.58% / 243,934 votes; initial count had AMLO +1 million (S00004-S00006)
- AMLO demanded vote-by-vote recount: alleged 50,000 of 130,477 casillas had ballots exceeding registered voters (S00007-S00008)
- Announced impugnación before TEPJF (S00009)

**Locator: extracted HTML block 34** (International validation; PRD legislative gains)

- OAS, EU, UN missions ratified cleanliness (S00001)
- US and Spain congratulated Calderón before TEPJF ruling (deadline Aug 31) (S00002)
- PRD/FAP legislative results: 157 deputies, 36 senators; did not extend impugnación to legislative/state elections (S00003-S00004)
- "Selective fraud" argument undermined (S00005)
- July 8 AMLO began total battle in institutions and streets (S00006)
- Zócalo rallies, increasingly radical tone; called IFE/Fox/Calderón "ariete," "traidor," "pelele" (S00007-S00009)
- July 16: called peaceful civil resistance with civil disobedience and road blockades (S00010)

**Locator: extracted HTML block 35** (TEPJF recount)

- Aug 5: TEPJF unanimously rejected full recount; ordered partial recount of 11,839 casillas (9% total, 149 districts, 26 states) (S00001)
- AMLO rejected ruling; Cárdenas disapproved protest campaign; AMLO called for intensifying resistance (S00002-S00004)
- Aug 15: invoked Art. 39 Constitution; called to end "simulated Republic" (S00005-S00006)
- Aug 28 TEPJF partial recount: ~4M ballots, 237,000 annulled; remaining validated no fraud; Calderón lost 81,000, AMLO 77,000; gap moved 0.58% → 0.56% (S00007-S00009)
- AMLO: "usurper… coup" (S00010)
- Calderón negotiated PAN/PVEM/PANAL chamber leadership (S00011)

**Locator: extracted HTML block 36** (Sept 2006: blockade, TEPJF validation, parallel gov)

- Sept 1: PRD deputies took tribune to block Fox's annual report (S00001)
- PRD parliamentary group joined negotiations with PAN, contradicting boycott threat (S00002)
- AMLO accepted only his victory or annulment (S00003)
- Sept 5: TEPJF validated elections, declared Calderón president-elect (gap: 233,831 votes); ruling final (S00004)
- AMLO: "¡al diablo con sus instituciones!" (S00005-S00006)
- Convención Nacional Democrática called; "itinerant" parallel government of 12 secretaries (S00007-S00008)
- Sept 16: hundreds of thousands (over 1 million per organizers) acclaimed AMLO as "legitimate president" in Zócalo (S00009)
- Nov 20 set for swearing-in; AMLO announced abolition of corruption regime and "new Republic" (S00010-S00011)

**Locator: extracted HTML block 38** (Dec 1, 2006 inauguration; parallel "legitimate presidency")

- Dec 1, 2006: PRD attempted to disrupt Calderón's inauguration; 3 days of tension, physical/verbal clashes (S00001-S00003)
- Calderón sworn in amid uproar, then moved to Auditorio Nacional (S00004-S00005)
- AMLO held rally + peaceful march from Zócalo; parallel government members flanked him; reiterated no truce against "traidor"/"espurio"/"pelele" Calderón (S00006-S00007)
- "No political normality until democracy in our country" (S00008)
- Book "La mafia nos robó la Presidencia" published July 2007 (S00009-S00010)

**Locator: extracted HTML block 39** (2007-2008 opposition period)

- 2007-2008: AMLO continued defending legitimacy, mass rallies in DF and national tours (S00001)
- No official executive/legislative mandate; external activism required (S00002)
- Support from intellectuals and filmmaker Luis Mandoki; "¿Quién es el señor López?" (2006), "Fraude: México 2006" (Nov 2007) (S00003-S00005)
- Confrontation strategy not shared by many in PRD; PRD elected officials worked normally; Calderón administration consolidated institutionally and diplomatically (S00006-S00007)
- No government worldwide recognized AMLO as president, including Bolivarian America led by Venezuela (S00008)

**Locator: extracted HTML block 4** (2012 election, MORENA founding)

- 2012: EPN (PRI) won, returning party to power after 12 years (S00001)
- AMLO (Movimiento Progresista, 31.6%, ~7 pts less than EPN) claimed fraud — "purchase" of 5 million votes; pursued legal channels without violent resistance (S00002-S00003)
- Sept 2012: AMLO left PRD (accused of personalism, inability to dialogue) (S00004-S00005)
- Founded MORENA to "peacefully overthrow" PRI-PAN duopoly and achieve democratic transformation (S00006)
- Refused Pacto por México; opposed structural reforms (energy, education, labor, telecoms) (S00007)
- Criticized Peña Nieto as corrupt, weak, incompetent on narco war, basic-basket/fuel prices, Trump (S00008-S00009)
